sources.verified_angle_summary: At LEAP 2026 in Riyadh, Huawei is showcasing its comprehensive suite of AI-powered enterprise solutions under the theme 'Advancing Industrial All Intelligence.' The company is demonstrating how the integration of AI, Cloud, and Big Data is driving digital transformation across various sectors. The showcase highlights Huawei's enterprise architecture, including advancements in data communication, storage, optical networking, and wireless infrastructure. Key innovations featured include the High-Quality 10 Gbps CloudCampus, OceanStor Scale-Out Storage, and the Xinghe Intelligent SASE Solution. The exhibit also details industry-specific intelligent solutions tailored for government, transportation, healthcare, electric power, finance, and mining, emphasizing practical applications of AI in accelerating industrial evolution. This angle provides a specific, verifiable look at Huawei's strategic positioning and technological offerings at the major regional tech event.
